title: Dominic and the Parish
author: Orsen Reyes
blurb: Bram Fairweather, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
